title: Human demo: Fighter, Marksman and Knight in fixed high-medieval crimson and gold heraldry (exploration, never registered)

recipes.editInstruction: Redraw him as a high-medieval man-at-arms: a deep crimson red surcoat with a bold gold-yellow cross on the chest and a gold hem, over steel chainmail sleeves; the round shield becomes a pointed heater shield painted crimson red with a gold-yellow lion; a gold band around the steel helmet under the crimson crest. Keep the face, sword, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the feet.
recipes.notes: Edit of the accepted production Fighter, so the silhouette stays and the other, unconverted Human units still match.

recipes.editInstruction: Redraw him as a high-medieval longbowman: a deep crimson red hood with a gold-yellow trim, a cream padded gambeson with a crimson and gold tabard on the chest, steel-grey hose, a dark brown leather belt, bracer and boots. Keep the longbow, quiver, face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the feet.

Redraw him as a high-medieval knight: the horse's cloth becomes deep crimson red with a wide gold-yellow trim; a crimson and gold surcoat over steel mail; a steel great helm with a gold crown band and a crimson plume; a small crimson and gold pennant below the lance point. Keep the white horse, lance, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hooves.
